definitions.gloss: to pass (an exam, inspection); to qualify
definitions.explanation: To pass a test, examination, or inspection by meeting the required standard. Used for school and license exams, job screenings, and quality checks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}した。
⟦{第一|だいいち}{志望|しぼう}→第一志望：19697_daiichishibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: I got into my first-choice university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ついに⟦{運転免許|うんてんめんきょ}→運転免許：15285_untenmenkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: I failed many times, but I finally passed the driver's license test.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧ (passing, success) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The thing passed is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}する (to pass an exam).

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the exam or target, not ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}する: to pass an exam
- ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格|ごうかく}する: to pass an inspection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受|う}かる→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧: to pass (an exam) — more casual, native-Japanese verb with the same meaning
- ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to get through; pass — broader, also used for screenings
- ⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fail — the antonym
